About us

The gym started in a rented warehouse with a borrowed drill and a lot of second-guessing. None of the three founders had run a business before, which shows in our accounting and, we like to think, not much else.

Marta Voss sets most of the technical routes and has been climbing for twenty-one years, the last nine of them with a reconstruction in her left shoulder that she will happily discuss at length. She also keeps the grade book.

Dev Oberoi handles the wall construction, the chalk inventory, and the music, which is to say he is the reason the gym is sometimes too loud and never, ever the reason it is boring. He has set for three gyms in two states and still labels every hold with painter's tape.

June Andrade started as a member in 2020, volunteered at the front desk for a year, and now runs the schedule, the junior program, and the coffee machine. She is the person who actually reads the waiver out loud.

We pay our setters per route, not per hour, and we publish the setting schedule on the front-door board. If you want to see how a wall goes up, the board says when.
